description.value:
Cast 10 minutes

Area 20-foot radius

Duration until you break it down

Set up a portable workshop; faster repairs and crafting in the field.

You unpack a workshop from what you are carrying. Inside its area you count as having a fully equipped workshop for every purpose, and downtime spent Crafting or Repairing there takes half the usual time. Breaking it down takes 10 minutes. You can maintain only one Field Foundry at a time.
